item.title: Hawaii under another hurricane watch as new storm closes in
item.description: Nolo is expected to become a hurricane sometime Thursday night and could become a major hurricane by the weekend as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 5 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo intensified back into a Category 5 storm — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast. Here's the latest on its path.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico's White House access for now
item.description: A federal judge temporarily blocked senior Trump administration officials from barring CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House and said their journalists' press credentials must be immediately restored.

item.title: Iran's president calls U.S. attacks "cowardly" as Trump threatens annihilation
item.description: U.S. and Iranian delegations met on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly, rekindling diplomacy amid Trump's threat to "annihilate" the regime.

item.title: Florida gov. candidate Byron Donalds responds after Trump mentions removed from site
item.description: Some prominent references to President Trump were scrubbed from Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds' campaign website in recent weeks, but the Republican said he isn't backing away from the president's agenda.

item.title: Sen. Tim Scott says GOP in "fight for our lives," sees path to holding Senate
item.description: With just under six weeks until the midterms, Sen. Tim Scott of South Carolina laid out the NRSC's strategy to try to hold onto the Senate amid a tough political environment.

item.title: Trump rolls out the red carpet for Xi despite U.S.-China tensions
item.description: It's not clear what specific goals President Trump wants to accomplish in his meeting with the Chinese leader.

item.title: Mortgage rates surpass 7% for first time in 2 years amid inflation, Iran war
item.description: The 30-year fixed rate mortgage in the U.S. has gone over 7% for the first time since May 2024. CBS News business contributor Javier David breaks down what's driving the spike.

item.title: ICE officer who shot Venezuelan man wasn't wearing body camera, sources say
item.description: The ICE officer who shot a Venezuelan delivery driver was not wearing a body camera at the time of the shooting, sources familiar with the investigation told CBS News.

item.title: What to expect from Taylor Swift as she releases new single, deluxe album
item.description: Taylor Swift announced a new single, "Patient Zero," and a deluxe version of her record-breaking album, "The Life of a Showgirl," this week as the VMAs and Grammy voting season approach. Bryan West, who covers Taylor Swift for USA Today, joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Harvard professor breaks down Trump's upcoming talks with China's Xi amid AI race
item.description: President Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping for a state visit as artificial intelligence safety discussions ramp up at the U.N. General Assembly. Graham Allison, a government professor at Harvard University, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss.

item.title: What do Trump and Xi hope to accomplish with summit?
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping traveled to Washington, D.C., on Wednesday for talks with President Trump. Politico China correspondent Phelim Kine joins CBS News to examine the summit's goals.

item.title: Legal expert breaks down White House media ban as federal judge still to issue ruling
item.description: President Trump's ban of CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from the White House is being challenged with a First Amendment lawsuit, but the judge has yet to issue a ruling. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks it down.

item.title: Gonzaga coach Mark Few on why he's urging the Senate to pass the Protect College Sports Act
item.description: The future of college sports could be decided this week on Capitol Hill, with the Senate expected to debate and vote on the Protect College Sports Act. Gonzaga University men's basketball coach Mark Few joins to discuss his support for the legislation.

item.title: Examining China-Iran relations amid Trump-Xi summit
item.description: President Trump greeted China's Xi Jinping at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday evening in an unusual presidential welcome for a foreign leader. CBS News Middle East contributor Courtney Kealy joins to discuss how the talks could affect the war in Iran.

item.title: Navy reports 8 suicide attempts on carrier group that faced monthslong deployment
item.description: There have been eight suicide attempts across the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group since the beginning of its grueling monthslong deployment last year, Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao said.

item.title: Dolly Parton's estate granted restraining order against her nephew
item.description: A Tennessee judge granted Dolly Parton's estate a temporary restraining order Wednesday against the late singer's nephew Bryan Seaver and his private security company.

item.title: Girl celebrating 6th birthday catches Eugenio Suarez's 350th home run ball, throws it back
item.description: A 6-year-old girl celebrating her birthday caught the 350th home run ball struck by Cincinnati Reds slugger Eugenio Suarez. She then threw it back.

item.title: California Six Flags rollercoaster left more than 100 people with brain injuries, attorneys say
item.description: Over 100 Six Flags visitors are accusing the X2 rollercoaster in Southern California of leaving them with traumatic brain injuries. Carter Evans has more.

item.title: How new Meta AI agent Muse differs from chatbots
item.description: Meta is announcing its latest artificial intelligence tools and smart glasses at its annual showcase on Wednesday. CNET AI reporter Katelyn Chedraoui joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Dolly Parton's nephew ordered by court to stay out of estate dealings amid extortion claims
item.description: Dolly Parton's nephew, Bryan Seaver, who had announced her death in a video last month, was ordered by a court to stay out of most of her estate's affairs after threat accusations. Nicole Valdes has the latest.

item.title: Trump is using summit to improve his relationship with Xi, former White House Asia adviser says
item.description: President Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping at Andrews Air Force Base on Wednesday evening. Georgetown University professor and former White House Asia adviser Evan Medeiros joins CBS News to assess what the pair's talks could focus on.

item.title: Former American Idol contestant on trial for wife's murder in Ohio
item.description: Caleb Flynn, a former American Idol contestant, is on trial in Ohio for the murder of his wife. Ian Lee has the story.

item.title: Judge dismisses Trump's 2024 lawsuit against Iowa newspaper over poll results
item.description: An Iowa judge sided with pollster J. Ann Selzer and The Des Moines Register, saying that allowing the lawsuit and its "faulty" claims to proceed could "discourage others from reporting on and debating public affairs."

item.title: 9/23: CBS Evening News
item.description: Both coasts bracing for extreme weather; Trump hosts China's Xi Jinping amid media boycott.

item.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in New York sexual assault case
item.description: Harvey Weinstein, the disgraced movie mogul, was sentenced to 15 years in prison Wednesday morning for sexually assaulting Miriam Haley at his Manhattan apartment in 2006.

item.title: Fat Bear Week 2026 is here, and voting already "broke the internet"
item.description: Sixteen bears are vying for votes in Fat Bear Week​ 2026, the highly anticipated contest among the chunkiest bears at the Katmai National Park and Preserve in Alaska.

item.title: Judge skeptical of Trump's White House ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description: A federal judge signaled he is skeptical of President Trump's ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House grounds.

item.title: Social Security tax hike "financially impossible" for many, expert says
item.description: Raising payroll taxes enough to stabilize Social Security could add thousands of dollars in annual costs, according to one analysis.

item.title: Shipwreck, apparent human remains found 7 years after boat sank in Atlantic
item.description: The nonprofit Green Oceans asked the Coast Guard to reopen an investigation that had classified the F/V Mistress as lost.
